'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israeli occupation of the West Bank]]
***The [[Israel]]i [[IDF|military]] announces the start of [[Operation Five Stones|a military operation]] in the [[Judea and Samaria Area|northern Samaria area]] in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/israel-begins-west-bank-operation-amid-settlement-expansion/a-74901208 (DW)]
*A [[Drone warfare|drone strike]] is carried out at the Khor Mor gas field in [[Sulaymaniyah]], [[Iraq]], causing major power cuts across the northern [[Kurdistan Region]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/drone-attack-targets-major-iraq-gas-field-kurdistan-security-sources-say-2025-11-26/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Holy See–Lebanon relations]], [[Holy See–Turkey relations]]
**[[Visit by Pope Leo XIV to Turkey and Lebanon]]
***[[Pope]] [[Pope Leo XIV|Leo XIV]] begins his first [[papal travel|papal trip]], first to [[İznik]] and [[Nicaea]] in [[Turkey]], then to [[Bkerké]], the [[Monastery of Saint Maron]], and the [[Port of Beirut]] in [[Lebanon]]. The trip will include an [[ecumenism|ecumenical]] commemoration of the 1,700th anniversary of the [[First Council of Nicaea]] and a [[Catholic mass|mass]] in honor of the victims of the [[2020 Beirut explosion]]. [https://apnews.com/article/vatican-pope-trip-turkey-lebanon-0b7733129e6f761d9a644aac4fb12e40 (AP)] [https://www.vaticannews.va/en/pope/news/2025-11/pope-leo-xiv-apostolic-visit-turkiye-lebanon-press-briefing.html (Vatican News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economy of Ukraine]], [[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Economic impact of the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Economic impact of the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***The [[International Monetary Fund]] announces a staff-level agreement with [[Ukraine]] on a proposed Extended Fund Facility worth more than [[US$]]8 billion, outlining [[Fiscal policy|fiscal]] and [[Monetary policy|monetary policies]] intended to support [[Macroeconomic stabilization|macroeconomic stability]], [[Debt-trap diplomacy|debt sustainability]], and [[external financing]] amid the [[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|ongoing war]] with [[Russia]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/russia-ukraine-war/article/imf-ukraine-reach-staff-level-deal-on-arrangement-worth-over-us8-billion/ (AFP via CTV News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Wang Fuk Court fire]]
**A fire at a housing estate in [[Tai Po]], [[Hong Kong]], leaves at least 94 people dead, dozens injured, and 279 more missing. [[Hong Kong Police Force|Police]] arrest three men for suspected [[manslaughter]] in the fire. [https://www.businesstimes.com.sg/international/hong-kong-arrests-three-alleged-manslaughter-deadly-fire (AFP via ''The Business Times'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/hong-kong-tower-fire-toll-rises-44-police-arrest-three-2025-11-26/ (Reuters)] [https://apnews.com/article/hong-kong-tai-po-wang-fuk-court-fire-d3da6740dd2c90f08d28dcd889db0c30 (AP)]
*[[Cyclone Senyar]], [[2025 Thailand–Malaysia floods]]
**The death toll from the [[flood]]s in [[Southern Thailand|southern]] [[Thailand]] increases to 33 people. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/thai-floods-death-toll-33-official-says-2025-11-26/ (Reuters)]
*Eleven people are killed when a [[UV Express]] van collides with a [[truck]] in [[Camalig, Albay|Camalig]], [[Albay]], [[Philippines]]. [https://mb.com.ph/2025/11/26/11-dead-in-uv-express-truck-collision-in-albay (''Manila Bulletin'')]
*Five people are killed in an explosion at a [[supply depot|weapons depot]] in [[Idlib Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2624044/middle-east (AFP via ''Arab News'')]
*A [[Swiss people|Swiss]] tourist is killed and another person is critically injured in a [[bull shark]] [[shark attack|attack]] off the coast of [[Crowdy Bay National Park]], [[New South Wales]], [[Australia]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cz68lglg5vlo (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Cyprus–Lebanon relations]]
**[[Cyprus]] and [[Lebanon]] sign a long-delayed [[maritime boundary]] agreement. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/lebanon-cyprus-finalize-sea-border-agreement-after-20-127889896 (AP via ABC News)]
*[[Dominican Republic–United States relations]], [[War on drugs]], [[2025 United States naval deployment in the Caribbean]]
**The [[Dominican Republic]] permits the [[United States]] to use the [[Las Américas International Airport]] in [[Punta Caucedo]], [[Santo Domingo Province|Santo Domingo]], and the [[San Isidro Air Base]] to support [[Operation Southern Spear]] targeting alleged [[Illegal drug trade in Venezuela|drug traffickers]] linked by the U.S. to [[Venezuela]]n authorities. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20251126-dominican-republic-to-allow-us-to-use-facilities-for-anti-drug-ops (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Foreign relations of Bosnia and Herzegovina]], [[Foreign relations of Hungary]]
**[[Ministry of Defence (Bosnia and Herzegovina)|Bosnian defence minister]] [[Zukan Helez]] denies approval for [[Hungary|Hungarian]] [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Hungary)|foreign minister]] [[Péter Szijjártó]] to land his [[Hungarian Defence Forces|military]] aircraft in [[Banja Luka]], [[Republika Srpska]], citing Hungary's support for former Srpska [[President of Republika Srpska|president]] [[Milorad Dodik]], whom Helez accuses of undermining [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]'s sovereignty. [https://www.reuters.com/world/bosnia-refuses-let-military-plane-carrying-hungarian-foreign-minister-land-2025-11-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[South Africa–United States relations]], [[2026 G20 Doral summit]], [[South African farm attacks]]
**[[U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] announces that [[South Africa]] will not be invited to the 2026 [[G20 summit]] in [[Doral, Florida|Doral]], [[Florida]], and that [[Government spending in the United States|U.S. payments and subsidies]] to the country will cease, citing South Africa's refusal to transfer [[G20]] hosting responsibilities to a [[Embassy of the United States, Pretoria|U.S. embassy]] representative at the [[2025 G20 Johannesburg summit|2025 Johannesburg summit]] and criticizing its treatment of [[Afrikaners]], among other reasons. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2624085/world (AP via ''Arab News'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 deployment of federal forces in the United States]]
**[[2025 Washington, D.C. National Guard shooting]]
***Two members of the U.S. [[National Guard (United States)|National Guard]] are shot and critically wounded in [[Washington, D.C.]]. The perpetrator, who is also wounded, is arrested. [https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20251126-two-national-guard-members-killed-in-shooting-near-white-house (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Women in Italy]]
**[[Women's rights in Italy]]
***The [[Italy|Italian]] [[Italian Parliament|parliament]] approves a bill to punish [[femicide]] with [[Life imprisonment in Italy|life imprisonment]]. [https://apnews.com/article/italy-femicide-law-crime-gender-violence-women-99e4be4aaba9f6b940d834ed6c7cb4d0 (AP)]
*[[Corruption in Peru]]
**A [[Peru]]vian [[Judiciary of Peru|court]] sentences former [[President of Peru|president]] [[Martín Vizcarra]] to 14 years in prison for accepting [[Bribery|bribes]] from construction companies while serving as [[Regional Government of Moquegua|governor]] of [[Department of Moquegua|Moquegua]] between 2011 and 2014. [https://www.trtafrika.com/english/article/38522ad72294 (AFP via TRT Afrika)]
*[[Murders of Yuna and Minu Jo]]
**Justice [[Geoffrey Venning]] of [[New Zealand]]'s [[High Court of New Zealand|High Court]] sentences 45-year-old mother Hakyung Lee to [[Life imprisonment in New Zealand|life imprisonment]] with a minimum non-[[parole]] period of 17 years after convicting Lee of [[Child murder|murdering her two children]] in 2018. [https://www.dw.com/en/new-zealand-suitcase-murders-mother-sentenced-to-prison-for-life/a-74899111 (DW)]
*[[Myanmar protests (2021–present)|Myanmar protests]]
**The [[Tatmadaw]] grants [[amnesty]] to over 3,000 [[political prisoners]], drops charges of over 5,500 others, and grants [[conditional release]] to 724 prisoners ahead of the [[2025–26 Myanmar general election|general election]] in December. [https://apnews.com/article/myanmar-military-amnesty-political-prisoners-76f591d2cfa82398bf6e38c64f22ba72 (AP)]
*[[Georgia (country)|Georgia]]'s [[Tbilisi Appeal Court]] sentences [[Opposition (politics)|opposition]] leader [[Nika Melia]] to an additional 18 months in prison for [[contempt of court]] after he threw water at a judge during a hearing, adding to the eight-month term he has been serving since May for [[Failure to appear|refusing to appear]] at a [[Parliament of Georgia|parliamentary]] [[Requests and inquiries|inquiry]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/jailed-georgian-opposition-politician-gets-extra-sentence-splashing-water-judge-2025-11-26/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Guinea-Bissau coup d'état]], [[2025 Guinea-Bissau general election]]
**[[Guinea-Bissau|Bissau-Guinean]] [[List of presidents of Guinea-Bissau|president]] [[Umaro Sissoco Embaló]] is detained following a [[coup d'état]] one day before provisional election results were expected to be released. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c0edww3qgq2o (BBC News)] [https://www.jeuneafrique.com/1743734/politique/guinee-bissau-umaro-sissoco-embalo-se-dit-victime-dun-coup-detat/ (''Jeune Afrique'' <small>in French</small>)]
*[[Kidnapping in Nigeria]], [[Religious violence in Nigeria]]
**[[Nigeria]]n [[President of Nigeria|president]] [[Bola Tinubu]] declares a nationwide [[State of emergency|security emergency]] and orders the recruitment of 20,000 additional [[Nigeria Police Force|police officers]] and the deployment of [[State Security Service (Nigeria)|specialised units]] in response to recent killings and kidnappings. [https://www.trtworld.com/article/5862b6ee58c5 (AFP via TRT World)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Chess World Cup 2025]]
**[[Chess in Uzbekistan|Uzbek chess]] [[Grandmaster (chess)|grandmaster]] [[Javokhir Sindarov]] wins the 2025 [[Chess World Cup|World Cup]] in [[Goa]], [[India]], at the age of 19, becoming the youngest player to win the event.
